why: Riot is Little China's main music club: a two-floor bar and dancefloor, a third-floor VIP lounge, a security room and backstage accessed from the garage. The kept Watson Little China open-world community phase still runs Riot's dancefloor crowd, staff and Animals door crew, but every other part of the venue is quest-only: the VIP lounge, the club security posts, the backstage crew and the third-floor regulars only exist while Violence or I Don't Wanna Hear It drive them. This proposal instantiates the two quest prefabs and restores the named bouncer, the friendly club security, the VIP-lounge occupancy (including Liam) and the house stage crew, with the house lighting variant.

open_questions: Does the kept Watson Little China community phase actually populate Riot in game? It activates #nightclub_com and #wat_lch_nightclub_bouncers directly from the sub-phase input, but if the district gate does not fire, those two whole-community activations must be added.

Are #riot_barman and #riot_bouncer spawners inside #sq017_pr_nightclub, #mq019_pr_night_club, or the always-loaded openworld prefab? Both candidate prefabs are declared; the tour must confirm the spawner resolves and that declaring both does not produce a duplicate/invalid prefab (rule 2).
Is the pachinko lift (security room / garage <-> street) usable without sq017_quest_bugfixes setting floor 0 active? If not, the back route is dead and the main entrance is the only way in.
Is #sq017_riot_vip_lift_door_1 unsealed by default, or does only the sq017 ForceUnseal make the VIP lift usable?
Does an Employee Badge exist anywhere in the clean-slate world? If not, the staff-only and backstage doors have no keycard and depend entirely on the runtime door policy.
Do the three backstage concert-crew entries read as house staff at work, or as leftovers of a concert that is not happening? Drop them if the tour looks staged.
